paper_metadata.title: OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework
paper_metadata.abstract: In this work, we pursue a unified paradigm for multimodal pretraining to break the scaffolds of complex task/modality-specific customization. We propose OFA, a Task-Agnostic and Modality-Agnostic framework that supports Task Comprehensiveness. OFA unifies a diverse set of cross-modal and unimodal tasks, including image generation, visual grounding, image captioning, image classification, language modeling, etc., in a simple sequence-to-sequence learning framework. OFA follows the instruction-based learning in both pretraining and finetuning stages, requiring no extra task-specific layers for downstream tasks. In comparison with the recent state-of-the-art vision & language models that rely on extremely large cross-modal datasets, OFA is pretrained on only 20M publicly available image-text pairs. Despite its simplicity and relatively small-scale training data, OFA achieves new SOTAs in a series of cross-modal tasks while attaining highly competitive performances on uni-modal tasks. Our further analysis indicates that OFA can also effectively transfer to unseen tasks and unseen domains. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/OFA-Sys/OFA.

extraction_data.innovation: Unified sequence-to-sequence learning framework for multimodal tasks; sparse coding for image representation to reduce sequence length; unified vocabulary for linguistic and visual tokens; encoder-decoder Transformer backbone with head scaling, post-attention layer normalization, and decoupled position embeddings (1D relative bias for text, 2D for images); joint pretraining on cross-modal and uni-modal tasks to enable zero-shot and fine-tuning across diverse modalities.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: CC12M, CC3M, SBU, COCO, VG-Captions, VQAv2, VG-QA, GQA, RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg, OpenImages, Object365, YFCC100M, ImageNet-21K, Pile (Filtered)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Cross-entropy optimization, CIDEr optimization based on reinforcement learning, Task-specific fine-tuning, Supervised fine-tuning and zero-shot instruction following
extraction_data.optimizer: Cross-Entropy, CIDEr optimization based on reinforcement learning
extraction_data.extension: Converts diverse modalities and tasks into a unified sequence-to-sequence format, eliminating the need for task-specific architectures or post-processing modules.
extraction_data.research_problem: Unifying architectures, tasks, and modalities through a simple sequence-to-sequence learning framework
extraction_data.application: Cross-modal understanding (visual question answering, visual entailment), multimodal generation (image captioning, referring expression comprehension, text-to-image generation)
extraction_data.paper_title: OFA: Unifying Architectures, Tasks, and Modalities Through a Simple Sequence-to-Sequence Learning Framework
extraction_data.finetuning_data: MSCOCO Image Caption, RefCOCO, RefCOCOg, GLUE benchmark, Gigaword, ImageNet-1K, VQA, SNLI-VE, MSCOCO, VQAv2, VG-QA, GQA, OpenImages, Object365, COCO
extraction_data.tokenizer: Byte-pair encoding (BPE) for text; image quantization/sparse coding for images.
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Self-attention, cross-attention, head scaling, 1D/2D relative position bias
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pretraining on plaintext data and image infilling; finetuning with Cross-Entropy and CIDEr optimization (RL)
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: CIDEr optimization based on reinforcement learning
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Globally shared multimodal vocabulary across all tasks
extraction_data.vision_encoder: ResNet50, ResNet101, ResNet152, ResNet module (first three blocks) for image processing
extraction_data.benchmark_result: SOTA in image captioning, VQA, visual entailment, referring expression comprehension; comparable to RoBERTa, ELECTRA, DeBERTa, UniLM, Pegasus, MoCo-v3, BEiT, MAE; VQA test-std: 91.2; SNLI-VE test-std: 91.2; MSCOCO CIDEr: 154.9

extraction_data.innovation: Unifies multiple architectures, tasks, and modalities into a single sequence-to-sequence model using a simple prefix-based instruction format; employs a shared encoder-decoder Transformer with a ResNet module for image processing and BPE tokenizer for text; supports zero-shot and fine-tuning across vision, language, and cross-modal tasks.
